nodes.text: @madrid_mike Not great but I still think that bird flu is the bigger threat. It didn't originate in California but we lost control of it.

nodes.author: bruceymonkey
nodes.text: @madrid_mike The other thing to consider is that so long as there are this many ppl we'll continue to have pandemics. Not saying that germs have brains but in evolutionary terms, if U're a pathogen that works on warm-blooded creatures, why Wouldn't you go for humans? We're the biggest target.
